collection.title: Skoda Superb Saloon 2015 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Skoda Superb Saloon 2015 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Slim Push Button arm attachment. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Skoda Superb which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
